articles.title: Live updates: Attorney says video supports man's account of Austin ICE shooting - Austin American-Statesman
articles.description: Follow live updates after a federal immigration agent shot a man in North Austin. Officials, attorneys and the mayor respond.
articles.content:
A federal immigration agent shot and injured 28-year-old Wilber Rafael Garces Perez on Sunday in North Austin, according to state and local officials.
